attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory with mode 1777 (world rwx + sticky bit), owned by root:root. Sticky bit ensures only a file's owner (or root) can delete/rename it, while any user can write into the directory. Functionally verified with two test users (alice/bob): both could create files, neither could remove the other's file (Operation not permitted), each could remove their own. Test users were removed afterward. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id and directory state, triggered a native reboot, polled through the outage until the node returned, confirmed a new boot_id (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and re-verified /srv/drop's permissions and write functionality post-restart.
